title: Penthouse July August 2010 Lela Star Brock Lesnar Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover bright with light wear. Back cover has scuffing and scratches across the dark ink (see photo 2). Spine intact.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July/August 2010 - 4th Annual Badass Issue & American Badass List. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover Girls: Lela Star & McKenzee Miles.

Cover features: Brock Lesnar - better than ever?; Stand-up at Sing Sing; Triple play with Red Bull's NASCAR team; Road Warrior - ride with Hell's Angel Sonny Barger.

Back cover: RAW rolling papers ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
